description: Use the person's own recording (a sound file on this computer) as a voice, free: for a script line (line), for a shot (it becomes that shot's line), or as a new line. Its words are heard on this computer when voice text is set up, so captions can follow them. cut_pauses takes out long pauses. One undo step. For an AI voice (paid) use speak; for music use music.

fit.description: true: the shot gets the recording's length.

line.description: A line id (script with action get) that this recording speaks.

path.description: Full path of the sound file (MP3, WAV, M4A...).

scene.description: Scene index from 0 (with shot). Used when shot_id isn't given.

shot.description: Shot index from 0 inside that scene (with scene; alone: in the scene on screen). A shot id works here too.

shot_id.description: Or: a shot's id; the recording becomes that shot's line. Or give scene and shot.

name: own_voice
